directive: an R1-shaped round over the R9 inventory (then R7/R8/R9 again), the heading-only-chunk convention decision (2026-10-03, zai-web)
mode: operator-delegate (C12/C13); the human operator retains final sign-off; reviewable and reversible before R5; zero promotion
definition: a chunk is heading-only iff norm(chunk text) == norm(chunk heading) under the shared norm() of the pinned c40 chunker, computed from a fresh re-chunking at every fill
ruling: a heading-only chunk is a structural slice of the corpus's own spec_point span; its chunk->SP row carries the SPAN's standing via the fail-closed evidence ladder

ladder.H1_verdict_standing: span anchor carries an operator id-verdict (R1 AFFIRM/CORRECT, R6/R10 CORRECT) or an R10 note-level 'join stands' adjudication -> CONFIRM (provenance names round + anchor + ruling)
ladder.H2_content_standing: the note carries >=1 CONFIRM at R4/R9 on the same spec_code whose own chunk is NOT heading-only -> CONFIRM (provenance names the confirming row(s))
ladder.H3_fail_closed: otherwise HOLD - explicit, recorded, never silently confirmed or re-rejected; un-holds automatically when H1/H2 becomes true

exclusions: a heading-only row's own prior CONFIRM (incl. C40-era carried confirms) does NOT satisfy H2 - only content-row confirms count
a REJECT-free history alone is not evidence - no clean-history branch
chunk identity, the chunker and chunk bytes are untouched (W3 invariant unaffected)
nothing promotes: the store stays SUGGESTED until R5 (operator gate 3)
r5_eligibility: H1/H2 rows are ordinary CONFIRM rows for the §18 apply; H3 rows ride R5 only with explicit operator sign-off plus a per-row listing, or stay SUGGESTED

H1.via: R10 note-level adjudication: the 1.8D join STANDS (ord-3 estimation-to-check surface)

H3_hold.why: no anchor verdict; zero content-row confirms of the note
no anchor verdict; zero content-row confirms of the note
